jurisdiction.name: British Virgin Islands
jurisdiction.constitutionalFoundation: Constitution of the Virgin Islands (2007). Final appellate court: Eastern Caribbean Court of Appeal → Privy Council.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the incorporation, operation and regulation of business companies.
primaryActs.summary: The BVI's flagship company law. Relevant for leasehold: the use of BVI companies as holding vehicles for strata-titled real estate, particularly in the BVI's offshore-property market.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to make provision for the registration of title to land in the Territory.
primaryActs.summary: Section 4 establishes the Land Registry; section 28 establishes the priority of registered interests; section 49 sets the rectification rules.

primaryActs.shortTitle: Conveyancing and Law of Property Act
primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to consolidate the law relating to conveyancing and the law of property.
primaryActs.summary: BVI's equivalent of the UK LPA 1925. Sections 45–55 cover the implied covenants in leases; section 146 grounds for forfeiture.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the administration of tax laws and for related matters.
primaryActs.summary: Governs how property-related taxes are collected and appealed. Section 31 deals with objections.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the development of strata-titled land and for related matters.
primaryActs.summary: Strata regime for the BVI. Section 17 deals with insurance; section 24 with sinking funds; section 34 with meeting procedure.

regulations.title: Condominium Regulations
regulations.summary: Form of by-laws, insurance trust, sinking-fund mechanisms.

leadingCases.caseName: Road Reef Tower Owners v BVI Holdings
leadingCases.headnote: Seafront building. The Tribunal held that wind-loading disclosures required by s.34 of the Condominium Act include BVI hurricane-zone modelling.

proceduralRules.title: Civil Procedure Rules
proceduralRules.summary: CPR governs civil procedure in the BVI High Court.

remedies.label: Body Corporate Sinking Fund Challenge
remedies.description: Challenge to a sinking-fund contribution under the BVI Condominium Act s.24.
